meta.source: FAA Releasable Aircraft Database (US government work, public domain)
meta.note: US registrations only. Airliners (30+ seats) and scheduled commuter types. `current` holds live (status V) registrations as [startDate, typeIndex]; `history` holds cancelled ones as [startDate, cancelDate, typeIndex] — real intervals, so a flight resolves to the aeroplane wearing the mark on that day, even when the mark has been reused more than once. Foreign marks are not in this registry.
